description: Return sessions whose lease has not expired, ordered by lease.expires_at DESC. Each row joins session_ledger__session with session_ledger__lease and carries session id, source_id, external_session_id, vendor, vendor_session_label, project_path, last_event_at, lease last_seen_at, and lease expires_at. 'Active' is defined as having a non-expired row in session_ledger__lease (INNER JOIN with l.expires_at > now()) — sessions whose source plugin recently pinged the lease are surfaced; sessions that have been idle past the lease TTL drop out automatically. Use this verb instead of raw SQL to see which sessions are currently being touched by their source plugins. Companion to list_sessions (history view across all sessions regardless of lease) and trigger_poll (the verb that advances leases on pulling sources).
embedding_description: List currently-active LLM session ledger sessions (INNER JOIN __lease where expires_at > now()). Returns id, source_id, external_session_id, vendor, vendor_session_label, project_path, last_event_at, last_seen_at, expires_at, ordered expires_at DESC. Use to see sessions actively being polled by their source plugins. Contrast with list_sessions (all imported sessions regardless of lease).
